about.title: About InkNova
about.p1: InkNova is a print studio for businesses and individuals who want sharp print without a complicated order flow.
about.p2: We collaborate with local printers to give our customers the best price and the best quality.
about.p3: From flyers and business cards to roll-ups and programmes – you pick the format, we handle the rest.

faq.title: FAQ – Questions & answers
faq.intro: Common questions below. Can't find what you need? Contact us.

items.a: Choose product and size, design in the editor, add to cart and pay. We'll send it by post.

items.q: Which file formats do you accept?
items.a: In the editor you upload PNG/JPEG into image slots. We export a print-ready PDF with 3 mm bleed and crop marks.
Yes – Vipps and card are coming in checkout. Until then, contact us to place an order.

items.q: Do I have a right of withdrawal?
items.a: Products are made to order, so withdrawal rights under § 22 letter e do not apply. See Returns & complaints.

articles.title: Articles
articles.intro: Tips on print, files and design.

items.title: What is a print-ready PDF?
items.excerpt: Bleed, crop marks and why they matter.
items.body: A print-ready PDF is production-ready: 3 mm bleed, crop marks and the right colour profile. When uploading to InkNova, use PDF or PNG. For best results, export with bleed and crop marks from your design tool.

items.title: How to choose the right size
items.excerpt: A-formats, business card sizes and when to go custom.
items.body: A5, A4 and A6 are common for flyers. Business cards have several centimetre options. Posters and flyers can also be ordered in a custom size within the max dimensions on the product page. The price updates when you change size.

items.title: RGB or CMYK – which should you use?
items.excerpt: Screens and print speak different colour languages. Here's how to avoid surprises.
items.body: Your screen shows colour in RGB (red, green, blue – light). Print uses CMYK (cyan, magenta, yellow and black – ink). Some vivid screen colours cannot be matched exactly in print, so the result can look slightly softer. For best control: work in CMYK in a pro design tool, or use our editor and preview before ordering. Small differences between screen and print are normal.

items.title: How sharp do images need to be?
items.excerpt: DPI, pixels and why soft images show up in print.
items.body: For print we recommend images around 300 DPI at the final size. A photo that looks fine on a phone can still be too small for an A4 flyer. Rule of thumb: the larger the print area, the more pixels you need. Prefer original files from a camera or design tool – not screenshots or heavily compressed social media images when you can avoid it.

terms.title: Withdrawal, complaints and claims
terms.intro: At InkNova we want you to be happy with the products you order. Below is information about your rights when buying made-to-order print.

withdrawal.title: Right of withdrawal
withdrawal.p1: All products ordered from InkNova are produced to the customer's specifications. This applies when you:
bullets: design the product yourself in our webshop
use our templates and customise them (e.g. replace logo, text or images)
withdrawal.p2: Production starts shortly after the order is placed. Because products are made to order and cannot be resold, the right of withdrawal under the Cancellation Act § 22 letter e does not apply.
withdrawal.p3: Please carefully check design, text, images, colours, measurements and other information before completing your order.

complaint.title: Right to complain
complaint.p1: You have a right to complain under the Consumer Purchases Act if the product has a production defect or differs from what was agreed.
complaint.applies: The right to complain applies if, for example:
appliesList: the product was made with the wrong material or size
the print has a production defect
the item was damaged in delivery due to production or packaging
complaint.notApplies: The right to complain does not apply if the fault is due to:
notAppliesList: typos, layout errors or other issues in a design you submitted, uploaded or approved
errors in finished files provided by the customer
errors or defects in text, logo or images placed in our templates by the customer
colours or graphics you added or changed in a template
minor colour differences between screen and print

how.title: How to complain
how.p1: If you find a fault, contact us as soon as possible and within a reasonable time after discovering it. Send us:
how.p2: We assess complaints as quickly as possible. If the complaint is justified, we will normally offer a reprint, fix, price reduction or refund in line with applicable law.

before.title: Important before ordering
before.p1: As a customer you are responsible for the design and content you submit being correct. InkNova does not check or proofread text, layout, spelling or image quality before production — including when using our templates or uploading finished files.
before.p2: By placing an order you confirm that the design has been checked and is ready for production.
